name: ZED Link Quad Capture Card

sources.title: ZED Link Quad Capture Card datasheet, rev1.1 (Stereolabs; linked from the Stereolabs store page)
sources.covers: compatibility, supported cameras, power, deserializers, temperature, weight, interfaces (J1/J2 FAKRA, J5 Samtec, J10 power, J17 GPIO)

note: A GMSL2 deserializer board "(Compatible with NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin)" that mounts on the Jetson's Samtec camera connector (J5, "Samtec QTH-060-04-H-D-A-K-TR", "Can be used with Orin AGX and Xavier AGX Developer Kits"). Inputs: "2x 4 GMSL2 I/O" on J1 and J2 (FAKRA Z 4x1; ports 2, gmsl_links 8); "Supports up to 8 ZED X GS / ZED X Mini GS / ZED X One GS and up to 4 ZED One 4k". "Deserializer: 2 x Maxim MAX96712". "Requires external 9V to 19V power supply (Typical power consumption ~0.29W)" (power_w 0.29, the typical figure). "Weight: ~ 55 g". Operating temperature -20 to +75 °C. Not stated: the GMSL2 link rate and the CSI-2 lanes to the Jetson (stated_mbps and lanes null), the size (only in a drawing).
interface: GMSL2 in (2x 4-way FAKRA Z); Samtec QTH-060 to the Jetson AGX camera connector

ingest.what: "2x 4 GMSL2 I/O" (J1 & J2, Fakra Z 4x1); "Deserializer: 2 x Maxim MAX96712"
